name: r2_lgbm_dm_huber
why: Error analysis: many top errors are label/structure errors (e.g. propyzamide given as propanamide). A Huber loss caps the influence of large residuals during training.

name: r2_lgbm_d_crip_pack
why: Group-contribution atom types + crystal-packing/melting-point proxies (MP is the missing term of the General Solubility Equation; errors grow with aromatic ring count).

name: r2_lgbm_dm_crip_pack
why: Same additions on top of the best round-1 feature set.

name: r2_lgbm_m2v
why: Pretrained chemical embedding (mol2vec) alone.

name: r2_lgbm_dm_m2v
why: Pretrained embedding added to the best feature set.

name: r2_lgbm_d_ap_tt
why: Alternative fingerprints (atom-pair, topological torsion) that encode longer-range topology than Morgan.

name: r2_lgbm_d_av_erg
why: Avalon substructure counts + ErG pharmacophore graph. [REPRODUCIBILITY FAIL: uses non-deterministic ErG; superseded by the *_erg2 retrain]

name: r2_catboost_dm
why: CatBoost on the best feature set (round 1 only ran CatBoost on RDKit descriptors).

name: r2_svr_m2v
why: Kernel model on the pretrained embedding: a different inductive bias for blending.

name: r2_svr_dm
why: SVR on the larger descriptor set (gamma = 1/n_features, the same scaling as round-1 SVR).

name: (exploratory) nnls+lgbm_residual_A

name: (exploratory) nnls+lgbm_residual_B
why: As A, stronger regularization. Not saved (CV-only).

name: r2_gnn_hybrid_ens2

name: r2_stack_ridge
why: Learned (unconstrained, regularized) linear stacker over the per-family best models.

name: r2_stack_lgbm_meta
why: Non-linear stacker that can weight models differently by molecule size, polarity, aromaticity, salt status and novelty (error analysis: errors depend strongly on these).
